claude.sample_unit: LLM responses to 3,000 Reddit venting and advice-seeking posts

links.outcome: Language/appraisal appropriateness of LLM emotional-support responses by persona (Soothe, Reframe, Endorse)
links.effect: Friend prompting increased Endorse and reduced Reframe; therapist prompting did the reverse; both increased Soothe relative to default. Lay raters detected only 60% of expert-confirmed Endorse instances.
links.quote: friend prompting increased Endorse and reduced Reframe, a pattern that could reinforce users' existing appraisals and plausibly contribute to escalation risk, whereas therapist prompting did the reverse.

links.outcome: Whether user-preference ratings detect appraisal-reinforcing behavior in LLM emotional support
links.effect: Lay raters detected only 60% of expert-confirmed Endorse instances and rated the personas similarly helpful and desirable.
links.quote: Preference-based evaluation thus has a blind spot: supportive presentation can obscure appraisal-reinforcing, potentially escalatory behavior.

unlisted_practices: Evaluate LLM emotional support with expert-informed measures of response behaviors (Soothe, Reframe, Endorse) rather than user preference alone

links.effect: Friend prompting increased Endorse and reduced Reframe; therapist prompting did the reverse; no effect sizes reported.
links.quote: Across 9,000 GPT-5.6 responses to 3,000 venting and advice-seeking Reddit posts, friend- and therapist-style personas both increased Soothe relative to default but moved Reframe and Endorse in opposite directions: friend prompting increased Endorse and reduced Reframe, a pattern that could reinforce users' existing appraisals and plausibly contribute to escalation risk, whereas therapist prompting did the reverse.

links.effect: Lay raters detected only 60% of expert-confirmed Endorse instances and rated personas similarly helpful and desirable.
links.quote: Two independent LLM judges substantially agreed with clinically trained raters, yet lay raters detected only 60% of expert-confirmed Endorse instances and rated the personas similarly helpful and desirable.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM judges to approximate clinically trained raters for emotional-support response evaluation
